notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Bounding Krasis and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Bounding Krasis.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Bounding Krasis from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
